items.title: APAC Recruiting Coordinator
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is growing quickly across Asia Pacific, and our International Recruiting Coordination team is building for it. As our first Recruiting Coordinator based in Singapore, you'll deliver a warm, high touch interview experience for candidates across APAC, including Japan, Korea, India, Australia, New Zealand and South East Asia. You'll partner closely with our APAC recruiters and recruiting managers, be the local point of contact for candidates and interviewers in the region and help keep hiring moving around the clock as part of a follow the sun coordination model with your teammates. As you'll be first in seat, you'll also help shape how coordination works in a region where we're still building: spotting what's missing, documenting what works and making it easier for the people who join after you. You'll own coordination for your region end to end and act as our go to operator for APAC hiring logistics, working independently with support from your manager. Responsibilities: Schedule a high volume of APAC interview loops, from hiring manager screens through onsites, debriefs and reference calls, across multiple time zones, languages and stakeholder calendars. Be the primary point of contact for candidates on logistics, with a warm, clear and culturally aware tone that makes every candidate feel supported and informed. Partner with recruiters and hiring managers as a trusted advisor: flag capacity risks, local holidays and market norms early, and help them see around corners. Keep our systems accurate for APAC roles, including Greenhouse job setup, interview plans; scheduling tool configuration and supervise automations. Provide coverage within our follow the sun model, with clean handoffs so candidates never feel the gaps between regions. Support recruiters and RecOps with regional hiring operations as our APAC footprint grows, such as new locations, entity changes, offer logistics and onboarding handoffs. Improve our processes and document what works. Independently scope and lead projects, from problem to adopted solution. Use AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow. You may be a good fit if you have: 4+ years of experience in recruiting coordination or high volume scheduling, ideally supporting multiple APAC markets. Experience coordinating across time zones and markets, with an understanding of local business norms across APAC. Hands-on experience with an applicant tracking system (e.g., Greenhouse) and a scheduling tool (e.g., ModernLoop, GoodTime). Excellent written communication, especially a knack for friendly, informative emails that build rapport and convey information clearly. Comfort creating structure where there isn't one yet, and the judgment to know when to escalate. Hands on fluency with AI tools, and the judgment to know when to trust the output and when to override it. A love of feedback, and comfort both requesting and providing it. Fluency in English (native or business-level). Additional APAC languages (e.g., Japanese, Korean or Mandarin) a plus. A genuine interest in Anthropic's mission and our deep commitment to AI safety. Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role • You'll be the catalyst driving the adoption and scaling of cutting-edge AI solutions. • You'll work at the intersection of innovation and impact, empowering businesses to leverage GenAI for transformative results. • You'll guide companies in integrating GenAI solutions, making AI a tangible part of their operations. • You'll drive the scaling of GenAI technologies, ensuring seamless transitions from concept to production. • You'll partner closely with our product and science teams to deliver state-of-the-art AI solutions tailored to client needs. • You'll tackle complex business problems with AI, delivering measurable outcomes and strategic advantages. • You'll contribute to the evolution of AI technology, influencing how businesses operate and compete in the modern world. • You will travel approximately 30 to 60% of your time. • Your role will involve spending time at the client’s office. What You Will Do Delivering value to the customers • Execute on effective technical discovery to understand potential clients' needs, challenges, and desired outcomes in collaboration with Account Executives. • Contribute to effectively identifying, qualifying, and disqualifying opportunities where Mistral solutions can unlock the most value for the customer. • On the project, Influence evaluation criteria and gain control of evaluations and the evaluation process • Create a strategic vision for the customer on the project, based on a deep understanding of their strategy, desired positive business outcomes, and required capabilities. Product deployment • Guide and support customers in deploying our models and products into their infrastructure. • Work closely with customers to deploy relevant solutions according to their specific requirements. • Regularly liaise with the product and technical teams to relay feedback and suggest improvements. • Develop custom features for customers as needed. Customer Onboarding • Responsible for onboarding customers on our products, providing guidance on deployment and integration • Ensuring the best production setup from the low-level GPU stack, up to infrastructure, back-end and front-end interfaces Project management • Define and track success metrics of the POC being rolled out at customers. • Operate as a program leader, leveraging internal Mistral teams (Applied Engineers) as well as teams on the customer side to make sure project moves forward. What We're Looking For • You hold a degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, etc.) • You have experience working as a DevOps, Site Reliability Engineer or Cloud Solution Architect • You're experienced with deploying and managing AI-based products in production environments • You are fluent in Python • You have experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes), as well as CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment tools • You have a deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premise infrastructure • You have been involved in a customer facing role • You have strong project & stakeholder management skills • You have foundational knowledge in AI/ML/Data science • You have ability to connect technology and business value • You are result driven and resilient • Being familiar with sales qualification concepts is a strong plus We are looking for adaptable team players who excel in a fast-paced environment and are ready to support pre-sales as well as deployment tasks, contributing to our shared goals and success. Hiring Process (optional) • Talent Acquisition screening call • 30min Hiring Manager Interview • 45min Business Acumen Interview • 60min System Design • Panel (Home Prep & Restitution) • 30min Value Talk • Reference check WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. items.title: Internal Audit Senior Associate
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Internal Audit function at Robinhood provides independent, objective, and timely assurance on the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal controls — helping to strengthen the organization's overall control ecosystem. Our team oversees governance across the Company and its regulated entities, and facilitates the communication of risk management information between RHM leadership and the Board of Directors and its Committees. We work closely with cross-functional partners across Brokerage, Crypto, Security, and Engineering to drive meaningful improvements to the control environment. We're a collaborative, high-performing group of auditors who take their work seriously — and love what they do! As an Internal Audit Senior Associate , you will play a key role in executing internal audits for Robinhood's International Entities, spanning Brokerage and Crypto products and integrated audits across multiple lines of business and jurisdictions. You will be a technically skilled, collaborative, and analytical professional with a strong understanding of risks, controls, and processes in a regulated Fintech setting. You'll contribute across the full audit lifecycle — from planning and execution through reporting and remediation validation — and build lasting relationships with business partners and management teams along the way. This role is based in our Ljubljana office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Support end-to-end audit procedures across the full audit lifecycle — including planning, execution, reporting, and remediation validation — across a portfolio of Robinhood EMEA entities. Responsibly apply generative AI and workflow automation throughout the internal audit lifecycle, while maintaining appropriate human oversight guardrails. Conduct audit procedures including walkthroughs, control testing, and substantive testing. Prepare testing work papers and audit documentation (flowcharts, narratives, risk & control matrices) to document controls, findings, and recommendations, including interpreting and concluding on the significance of audit findings. Draft clear, concise audit reports and present findings to audit leadership and auditees. Collaborate with internal audit team members and support third-party engagements to assist with audit execution and reporting. Participate in audit discussions with management teams across Brokerage, Crypto, Security & Engineering. Build collaborative relationships with business and cross-functional partners. Support audit leadership with risk assessments and development of the Internal Audit Plan, aligned to the strategic direction of the parent company audit program. Participate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned. What you bring Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g. Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or Computer Engineering). 5+ years of auditing experience, including exposure to Operations, Risk Management, Compliance, or IT/Information Security. Strong technical expertise and analytical skills, with the ability to communicate and partner with business, engineering, data, and product teams. Ability to thrive in fast-paced environments, work with ambiguity, and adapt quickly to change. Ability to operate independently while juggling multiple projects and initiatives in a dynamic, high-tech environment. Professional auditor certification (e.g. CIA issued by the Slovenian Institute of Auditors (SIA), CISA, ACCA, CPA). Passion for Robinhood's products and our mission to democratize access to global financial systems. Work experience in industries such as e-money, payment services, brokerage, or crypto financial products (e.g. payments, lending, spot, derivatives, tokenization). Familiarity with licensing and regulatory compliance requirements in Europe and Asia (e.g. MiCA, CASP/VASP, PSD2, MiFID II, MAS, DORA, GDPR, AMLD). Some exposure to direct communication with financial regulators (e.g. ATVP, Central Bank of Lithuania, CSSF, ESMA, FCA, MAS). What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact and bonus programs. Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs. Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As Claude's capabilities grow, so does our responsibility to ensure those capabilities reach the right people. The Access Programs team builds the systems that verify who our customers are, grant access to advanced model capabilities for approved use cases, and ensure that access is not misused. As a software engineer on this team, you will build the identity, vetting, and access management infrastructure that underpins our trusted access programs, along with the monitoring and enforcement tooling that keeps them safe. This work sits at the center of how Anthropic deploys frontier capabilities responsibly, balancing broad access with rigorous safeguards. Responsibilities: Build identity verification and vetting systems (KYC/KYB) that establish who our individual and business customers are Design and implement access control systems that grant, scope, and revoke access to advanced capabilities based on approved use cases Build infrastructure to configure safety systems and detection thresholds on a per-customer basis for trusted access programs Develop monitoring to detect misuse of expanded access, and tooling that enables enforcement teams to act on it Partner closely with policy, enforcement, threat intelligence, product, research, and go-to-market teams so that access decisions are well-informed and consistently applied Build systems that identify account compromise and takeover, apply mitigations in real time, and carry affected accounts through to full remediation Design and build the dashboards, alerting, and internal admin tooling that give the team and its partners clear visibility into the health and outcomes of our access programs Integrate with third-party identity verification and data enrichment vendors You may be a good fit if you have: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or comparable experience Experience building and operating backend systems in production Strong coding skills in at least one general-purpose programming language, and experience building software with AI coding tools Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders Care about the societal impacts of AI and want your work to make powerful systems safer Strong candidates may also: 8+ years of industry software engineering experience Experience building shared platforms or foundational services that many teams and products depend on, rather than one-off solutions for a single use case A track record of working across functions (for example engineering, product, policy, operations, and go-to-market) to gather requirements, reconcile competing needs, and drive adoption of what you build Experience with identity, authentication, or authorization systems at scale Experience with KYC/KYB workflows or identity verification vendors Experience in trust and safety, integrity, fraud, or abuse detection Experience detecting and responding to account takeover or credential compromise Experience partnering with operational teams to build custom internal tooling The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Senior Technical Recruiter
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Recruiting team helps bring together the people who advance our mission of ensuring artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. We partner closely with leaders across the company to identify exceptional talent, build thoughtful hiring processes, and deliver an outstanding candidate experience. This role supports Applied Foundations, partnering with engineering leaders to hire the managers and senior leaders who will help build and scale OpenAI’s foundational engineering capabilities. About the Role We’re looking for an experienced technical recruiter with a strong track record of hiring engineering leaders. You’ll own leadership searches from initial role definition and talent mapping through assessment, offer negotiation, and close. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior engineering leaders, helping clarify what each role requires, understand the talent market, and make thoughtful hiring decisions. You’ll bring the judgment to navigate ambiguous searches, the credibility to engage accomplished engineering leaders, and the persistence to build relationships well before someone is ready to make a move. Experience in executive search or an in-house leadership recruiting function is particularly valuable. You should be equally comfortable shaping a search strategy and personally doing the work to deliver a successful hire. In this role, you will: - Lead full-cycle searches for senior engineering leaders across Applied Foundations. - Partner with hiring leaders to define role scope, leadership expectations, technical requirements, and the outcomes a successful hire will deliver. - Develop talent maps and targeted search strategies, combining direct sourcing, referrals, market research, and long-term relationship building. - Engage passive leadership candidates through thoughtful outreach and substantive conversations about their experience, motivations, and potential impact at OpenAI. - Partner with hiring teams to assess leadership capabilities, including building teams, developing managers, setting technical direction, and leading through change. - Advise senior stakeholders using market intelligence and search evidence, including when to revisit requirements, broaden a talent pool, or adjust the hiring approach. - Own complex closing strategies, partnering with hiring leaders and compensation colleagues to navigate competing opportunities, equity considerations, counteroffers, and career decisions. - Maintain a rigorous operating rhythm across searches, communicating progress, surfacing risks early, and delivering a consistent, thoughtful candidate experience. - Strengthen leadership recruiting practices by sharing insights, improving assessment approaches, and helping teammates navigate challenging searches. You might thrive in this role if you: - Bring substantial technical recruiting experience, with a demonstrated track record of personally owning and closing engineering leadership searches. - Have experience in executive search, in-house leadership recruiting, or a comparable environment requiring targeted research, senior stakeholder partnership, and discretion. - Can evaluate leadership scope beyond titles and partner with hiring managers to distinguish technical expertise, people leadership, and organizational impact. - Build credibility with senior engineering leaders and offer clear recommendations, including constructive pushback when needed. - Have successfully managed complex offers and understand how compensation, role scope, organizational context, and personal motivations influence a leadership candidate’s decision. - Combine strategic judgment with strong sourcing and execution skills, taking ownership from search kickoff through close. - Learn unfamiliar technical domains quickly and adapt effectively as priorities or role requirements evolve. - Communicate clearly, handle sensitive information thoughtfully, and approach feedback with humility and a willingness to update your perspective. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Millions of people now use Perplexity to transform knowledge into action, through Search, Comet, and Computer. Product Engineering owns those experiences end to end, from the interface a user touches to the search and model calls behind it, on top of roughly 200M queries a day and a 200B+ URL index. items.title: Applied Risk Standards Architect
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We believe that achieving our goal requires effective engagement with public policy stakeholders and the broader community impacted by AI. Accordingly, our Global Affairs team builds authentic, collaborative relationships with public officials and the broader AI policymaking community to inform and support our shared work in these domains. We ensure that insights from policymakers inform our work and – in collaboration with our colleagues and external stakeholders – seek to shape policy so that it aligns with and supports our mission. About the role OpenAI is looking for an Applied Risk Standards Architect to lead standards work for applied risk in applications, including mental health, youth safety, age assurance, functional efficacy, reliability, and privacy-related risks. You will help turn internal research, safety policies, and evaluation methods into technically sound, measurable, and adaptable standards that build public trust and support responsible deployment. This role sits within our AI standards and global assurance function in Global Affairs. Working closely with Safety Systems, Research, Product, Model Policy, Legal, and third-party evaluators, you will author proposals, negotiate requirements, and represent OpenAI in priority standards bodies. You will take on the drafting and external engagement needed to advance this work, enabling technical experts to focus on the underlying methods and evidence. You will also bring emerging requirements back into internal planning before they become established expectations. Alongside this primary portfolio, you will support the AI Standards and Global Assurance Lead on frontier AI assurance, contributing to risk-management standards, evaluation and benchmarking requirements, and approaches to independent assessment. The role connects technical practice with external standards. It does not replace the teams responsible for evaluation methods, safety decisions, controls, internal compliance, or implementation. You will own standards drafting, review coordination, negotiation, and assessment-design contributions within an agreed mandate. In this role, you will - Lead the development of applied AI risk standards. This includes working with technical and policy teams to define and advance standards for mental health, youth safety, age assurance, efficacy, reliability, and privacy-related risks, with a particular focus on evaluations and assessments. - Work with technical owners to turn research, internal policies, and evaluation methods into credible test methods, assessment criteria, and standards grounded in real system behavior. - Bring emerging requirements into internal planning and work with responsible teams to clarify their implications for evaluations, controls, and assurance for our products. - Work with technical and GRC partners on assessor competence, independence, conflicts of interest, evidence access, reporting, and the distinction between management-system audits and technical evaluations. - Contribute drafting, representation, and coordination on frontier risk-management and independent-assessment standards. - Lead assigned standards-body workstreams, negotiate proposals, and coordinate internal input, reducing the external engagement burden on technical experts. Contribute to relevant ISO/IEC, INCITS, NIST consortium, and cross-industry work. - Maintain clear approvals, negotiating positions, contribution records, and implementation handoffs so that external commitments remain connected to technical owners and available capacity. You might thrive in this role if you - Have technical depth in evaluation science, AI evaluations and red teaming, AI safety, or trust and safety, combined with demonstrated ability to translate that expertise into credible standards or assessment methods. - Have authored or materially shaped standards, evaluation criteria, control frameworks, or normative technical contributions—not only coordinated participation. - Can translate a broad safety objective into a clear requirement and explain what evidence would demonstrate that it has been met. - Understand the differences among organizational risk-management processes, model and system evaluations, mitigation testing, and broader assurance claims. - Can evaluate sensitive, context-dependent outcomes, including uncertainty and variation across users and use cases, without overstating what a benchmark or assessment can establish. You do not need to be an expert in every risk domain. - Understand how assessor competence, independence, incentives, and access affect the credibility of an assessment. - Can build consensus without sacrificing technical rigor, and know when to compromise, challenge a proposal, or escalate a decision. - Earn trust with technical teams while communicating clearly with lawyers, executives, policymakers, and external standards participants. - Write precisely, exercise discretion, and can independently move a defined workstream from initial proposal through review, negotiation, and handoff. items.title: Head of Sourcing Enablement & Delivery
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM Strategic Sourcing & Procurement helps OpenAI secure the products, services, and partnerships that support our research, build our products, and grow our business. We work with teams across the company to make sound commercial decisions and move important work forward. As OpenAI grows, we are rethinking how sourcing works: bringing expertise into decisions earlier, simplifying contracting, and using AI to give Procurement more time for judgment and strategic work. What we learn internally—and through our supplier and enterprise-buyer relationships—can also inform better products, partnerships, and industry adoption. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a senior leader to head Sourcing Enablement & Delivery, leading sourcing operational delivery, contracting enablement, and AI transformation—and building Procurement’s contribution to OpenAI’s commercial growth. You will build the teams, systems, service model, and cross-functional partnerships that enable sourcing and contracting at scale, helping teams move quickly without losing commercial discipline or accountability. You will partner with GTM, Sales, and Partnerships to develop Procurement’s contribution to OpenAI adoption and commercial growth. Bring procurement-industry knowledge, buyer insights, and lessons from internal AI use into customer engagement, product feedback, and opportunities across the procurement ecosystem. Reporting to the Head of Strategic Sourcing, you will manage the Sourcing Delivery and Contract Management leaders and shape this new function’s priorities, team, and measures of success. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. PRIORITIES AND WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - A focused roadmap: clear choices about what to build first, what to defer, and how progress will be measured. - Stronger delivery: capable leaders and teams, faster execution, less rework, and fewer unresolved ownership gaps. - AI adoption: sustained use of AI-enabled capabilities, with measurable gains in quality, capacity, and user experience. - Commercial results: increased OpenAI adoption across the procurement industry and a measurable contribution to commercial growth, consistent with independent supplier selection and purchasing decisions. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Build and lead the organization. Hire and develop managers, coach performance, and build succession and leadership depth. Decide how employees, contractors, delivery partners, and AI share the work. Hold leaders accountable for results, capacity, and team health. - Own sourcing enablement and delivery operations. Set service commitments and quality standards with the Delivery and Contract Management leaders. Match support to deal complexity and risk, and use internal customer feedback to improve the service. Category and Sourcing leads retain ownership of their strategies and deals, including supplier selection, negotiations, and purchasing. - Lead the sourcing operating rhythm. Bring demand, priorities, and capacity into one forward plan, informed by workload and performance data. Work with category leaders to make tradeoffs, resolve dependencies, and follow through on commitments. Provide inputs to Procurement-wide planning and functional business reviews. - Strengthen contracting. Partner with Legal and Procurement Operations/COE on contract lifecycle management, approved templates, and negotiation playbooks that improve quality and free category teams to focus on strategic deals. - Lead RACI development. Define responsibilities, decision rights, handoffs, and escalation paths within Procurement and across partner teams. Define how the team prioritizes work, allocates resources, and resolves delivery issues. - Create mechanisms to bring sourcing into decisions earlier: connect business demand, supplier activity, and renewals—including work outside formal intake—with Sourcing teams, so options can be shaped before commitments and Finance and cross-functional teams can have better visibility. - Build and prove AI-enabled ways of working. Own use-case priorities, adoption, and business outcomes for sourcing and contracting experiences that begin in ChatGPT and connect to trusted enterprise systems. Partner with Finance Enterprise Technology on technical delivery and with Legal, Security, and Operations on controls and support, including preserving access restrictions and contractual commitments. Turn what works into reusable capabilities, demonstrations, and product feedback. - Define Procurement’s commercial-enablement approach with GTM, Partnerships, Legal, and Compliance including program scope, decision rights, purchasing independence, and information-sharing boundaries. Lead Procurement’s analysis, coordination, and follow-through for approved programs; GTM owns customer sales. Maintain independent purchasing decision-making and identify and escalate any proposed linkage between OpenAI’s purchasing commitments and customer sales. - Help define goals and measures of success for Procurement’s contribution to OpenAI adoption and commercial growth with Sourcing leadership and cross-functional partners. - Bring procurement-buyer expertise into GTM. Own this team’s buyer insights and use cases. Work with Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Partnerships to shape demonstrations, industry content, and customer conversations, using examples approved for external use. - Drive OpenAI adoption across the procurement industry. Work with Sourcing leadership, partners and GTM to explore how Procurement third-parties and partners can adopt and distribute OpenAI capabilities. Contribute industry expertise and evidence from internal use; GTM and Partnerships own commercialization. - Partner with Legal and Compliance to embed business-integrity and confidentiality safeguards; implement required disclosures, recusals, and independent-decision making arrangements. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have 12+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, vendor management, or commercial leadership, with strong judgment about supplier choices, negotiations, contracts, and risk. - Have built or transformed a procurement capability through rapid growth or change, with clear evidence of better execution, commercial outcomes, or user experience. - Have managed managers and developed strong teams through hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and thoughtful use of internal and external capacity. - Have worked in or closely with marketing, sales, or commercial teams, ideally serving procurement buyers. You can turn customer needs into use cases and business cases, and deliver commercial results with partner teams. - Know the procurement industry—its buyers, technology providers, service firms, and buying priorities. You understand how to sell to Procurement, including how buyers assess risk, negotiate, and secure internal support. - Use industry analysts, market research, buyer conversations, and professional networks to form a point of view on emerging trends and inform roadmaps, partnerships, and GTM priorities. - Have turned AI, automation, or enterprise technology into capabilities people use. You can work with technical partners, drive adoption, measure improvements, and recognize where human judgment remains essential. - Can set direction when the path is not defined. You prioritize work and resources, explain tradeoffs plainly, and earn support from teams you do not manage. You are curious about AI and willing to test, learn, and change course. You’ll track progress, manage dependencies, make sequencing decisions, and drive 0→1 prototypes through MVP and scale. You will also share field insights with Product and Research to guide roadmap and priorities. Success will be measured first and foremost by impact - deployments that deliver measurable value against customer goals, drive adoption, and become critical to their workflows. Additional measures of success include delivery reliability (milestones hit), operating leverage (patterns reused across deployments), judgment under pressure, and product impact (field signal that shifts roadmaps). Translate business objectives into a roadmap with milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. Run day-to-day engineering execution and keep progress unblocked. - Shape account strategy with the account director. Build relationships with customer executives from scoping through adoption. items.title: Corporate Communications Manager (m/f/d)
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team As a Corporate Communications Manager, you will play a central role in shaping our corporate narrative on a global scale with a strong focus on Germany. Coming from a fast-paced fintech, finance, or startup background, you know how to translate complex business and macroeconomic developments into compelling stories. You are a proactive networker who thrives on building strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders. In this role, you will have the exciting opportunity to take ownership of corporate topics, drive innovation, and act as a reliable point of contact for the media. Your Responsibilities Corporate & Macro Topics: Take ownership of corporate and macroeconomic topics, positioning the company as a thought leader in the industry. Data-Driven Storytelling: Analyze internal and external data to craft interesting stories, unique angles, and compelling narratives that capture media attention. Editorial Planning: Create and maintain a full editorial calendar to ensure consistent planning, alignment, and execution. Format Innovation: Be accountable for projects focused on introducing and developing new external communication formats (e.g., industry reports, executive positioning, creative campaigns) to engage our target audiences. Media Relations: Serve as a dedicated point of contact for the media. You are happy to meet with journalists on a regular basis to pitch stories and build long-lasting relationships. Stakeholder Management: Actively build, nurture, and manage relationships with key internal executives and external stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment and cohesive messaging. Content Creation: Draft high-quality corporate materials, including press releases, briefing documents, statements, and opinion pieces. Media Coordination: Coordinate media activities, including briefings and interviews. Monitoring & Risk Management: Monitor the financial media landscape and competitive activity to surface PR opportunities and proactively manage potential risks to reputation. Global Alignment: Ensure that all corporate communications are aligned with our global strategy, seamlessly collaborating with international teams. Your Profile Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, or a related field. Minimum of 3+ years of relevant professional experience in corporate communications, PR, or journalism. Excellent communications skills, written and spoken, in both German and English. Strong background in the fintech, finance, or high-growth startup scene. Proven ability to build trust and strong relationships with both internal management and external partners. Highly analytical with a knack for turning dry data into exciting, newsworthy stories. Confident spokesperson with a proactive approach to building press relationships and pitching to the media. Hands-on mentality with a strong drive to actively develop and implement new external communication formats from scratch. Nice to Have An existing, warm network of media contacts (especially within DACH financial, tech, or business media). Practical experience in crisis communication and reputation management. Familiarity with AI-powered tools for communications, content creation, and video generation. Familiarity with PR tools and media monitoring platforms. Experience handling executive communications or CEO positioning. Hands-on experience with video editing tools and visual media production. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year. Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days. A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%. Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month. Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs. Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office. You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation. Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

items.title: Applied AI Software Engineer - Defense
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ABOUT THE ROLE Join Mistral AI’s Defense team to build software for defense institutions and industry. We are looking for an experienced software engineer with strong engineering fundamentals and a background in data engineering or transactional, analytical or distributed systems. You will help shape the architecture, write production code and own substantial software components, from design through deployment and operation. This role offers the scope and autonomy of a senior technical individual contributor in a small team. It is particularly suited to engineers operating at Senior or Staff level in demanding product engineering environments who want broad ownership and to stay deeply involved in implementation. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Design and build services for data ingestion, transformation, storage, querying and operational workflows. - Develop shared data models, APIs and SDKs that help engineers build applications on a consistent foundation. - Make authorization a core part of the architecture: define and enforce which users, applications and agents can access data or perform actions, with clear audit trails. - Solve problems involving data consistency, schema evolution, concurrency, performance and failure recovery across services and data systems. - Turn needs from our applied engineers and defense users into reusable software capabilities, making pragmatic choices about what to build and how to evolve them. - Own delivery end to end, including implementation, testing, observability, debugging and maintainability in demanding deployment environments. - Use AI coding tools and coding agents extensively to accelerate implementation, testing, refactoring and debugging. Help the team improve these workflows while maintaining a high engineering standard. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - Strong practical familiarity with AI coding tools and agentic engineering workflows. You use coding agents regularly, can break complex work into well-scoped tasks, provide effective context, review generated code and validate the result through tests and debugging. You remain accountable for the architecture, correctness, security and maintainability of what you ship. - A strong track record of building and operating production software, with substantial ownership of complex systems. - Experience in data engineering or in building transactional, analytical or distributed systems. You understand the trade-offs behind data models, storage, query execution and service boundaries. - Experience building products where access control, permissions and data governance are central to how the system works. Work on platforms such as Foundry, or systems with comparable requirements, is particularly relevant. - Broad software engineering skills and the ability to move between architecture, implementation and production debugging. You are comfortable working across unfamiliar parts of a codebase. - Strong proficiency in Python or another programming language, solid SQL skills and the ability to become productive quickly in a Python and TypeScript environment. - High autonomy and sound judgment: you can turn an ambiguous problem into a concrete plan, make technical decisions and deliver useful increments with limited supervision. - A collaborative approach to technical leadership through code, design discussions, reviews and mentoring, and a clear motivation to build software for defense institutions and industry. NICE TO HAVE - Experience building a data platform or developer product used by other engineering teams. - Experience with fine-grained authorization, multi-tenant architectures, data lineage or auditable operational workflows. - Experience with self-hosted software, restricted networks or other demanding deployment constraints. - Familiarity with LLM applications and their integration with data and tools. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Software Engineering Manager - Wallet Tribe (Crypto & Fiat)
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to own payments at Easygo - a crew surpassing 1,500 globally, powering Stake and KICK, two of the world’s largest online entertainment and livestreaming platforms. Lead in an environment that champions innovation, continuous learning, and professional advancement. We're seeking visionary leaders who can guide and inspire talented individuals, fostering an environment that thrives on solving intricate problems, crafting scalable solutions, and collaborating with the finest engineers in the entertainment industry. Complex Projects, Creative Solutions: Lead teams tackling projects that push boundaries, encouraging creative solutions to complex technical challenges. Collaboration with Industry Leaders: Drive innovation forward by fostering collaboration and idea exchange with top-tier engineers. Caring Culture, Career Development: Our culture prioritises your team's growth, offering tailored learning programs and mentorship to elevate their careers. Embrace Challenges, Celebrate Success: Encourage your team to embrace challenges, learn from setbacks, and celebrate collective achievements. Shape the Future: Your leadership will shape the future of entertainment, contributing to cutting-edge advancements in the industry. What you’ll build with us: The Payments team owns every aspect of how money moves in and out of our global entertainment product - from traditional fiat payments to crypto deposits, withdrawals, and on-ramping experiences that make digital assets accessible to millions of users globally. Operating within a platform handling ~4 billion requests per day, the team works on systems processing ~3,000 bets per second and ~95 billion bets annually, with transaction volumes continuing to grow by tens of millions every week. Working closely with product managers, designers, and operational teams, you’ll build and evolve highly scalable transaction processing platforms, wallet infrastructure, and seamless payment experiences across both fiat and crypto ecosystems. The team is central to Stake’s global expansion efforts, enabling new markets, currencies, payment providers, and crypto capabilities as the platform continues to scale worldwide. This is a true “you build it, you run it” engineering environment with end-to-end ownership - from shaping product features and architectural direction through to implementation, scalability, reliability, and operational excellence in production. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Lead and support multiple engineering squads to deliver high-quality solutions, ensuring alignment with organisational goals. Mentor and coach team members, including tech leads, helping them grow technically and professionally through feedback, career development plans, and tailored learning initiatives. Provide a clear strategic vision, ensuring teams work cohesively toward common goals. Contribute hands-on where necessary, including technical design reviews, code reviews, and assisting in critical incident escalations to unblock the team. Establish delivery excellence practices, ensuring processes and workflows are effective, efficient, and scalable. Promote a culture that encourages learning from challenges, celebrates successes, and drives collective team achievement. Your track record: Proven software engineering experience, with a strong foundation in building and delivering production systems. Proven track record of managing multiple squads of high performing engineering teams. Proven experience developing and executing strategic plans for engineering initiatives, aligning them with business objectives. Significant experience mentoring and coaching engineers and tech leads. Experience solving complex technical and organisational challenges Solid understanding of scalable systems, modern development practices, and engineering best practices. Effective communicator who can collaborate seamlessly with leaders from other departments, ensuring alignment and effective execution of initiatives. Benefits that give you the Easygo Edge, so you can build the future of fearless tech with us: Disrupt: we push boundaries and play to win Ballots for major sporting and music events Time with our partners and ambassadors, and exclusive office sessions with leading streamers, creators and industry guests Spin the Wheel Fridays on your birthday and work anniversary, with prizes up to $1,000 or a car EV subscriptions, novated leasing, energy savings through Origin, and everyday discounts and cash back through Paylab Rewards Evolve: we’re in constant motion, personally and professionally The ultimate sandbox: 1 in 3 of our people level up their role every year. If you deliver, you move. Market-synced pay, a performance-based bonus and a high-value referral bonus 30 days combined annual and personal leave for full-time employees 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers and 2 weeks for secondary carers, plus a 12-week return to work with fully paid Fridays off Employee Assistance Program for you and your family, and 7% off Bupa health cover with extras waiting periods waived Wednesday massages, a meditation space, parenting facilities, and bike storage, lockers and showers for active commuters Unify: we move as one and win together Daily catered breakfast, free barista coffee, juices and smoothies, and snack walls and drink fridges on every floor Pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles, an F1 simulator, social sports teams and the Corporate Games Mid-year and end-of-year celebrations, team budgets for wins and milestones, and a paid volunteer day each year Benefits apply to Australian-based employees, are subject to eligibility and program terms, and may change. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.
